aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was founded by Dominic Bonini, who built Village Foodie to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. It is a small company that he runs himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I watched, the more convinced I became that they deserve better tools: built for a business that is somewhere different every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That is why I founded HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It is a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, I will answer you, not a support desk queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come to it, but I never knew which one would come or when unless I searched Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I built Village Foodie — a simple way to see which food trucks are coming to nearby villages.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order ahead for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Analyse sales by period, dish and event — you will see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When handing out a buzzer, assign its number to the order — you will know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck is shown on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your website. Each date leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with your own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine dishes into meal deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff separate logins with the right access level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering is paused so customers cannot place orders you would not see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you can take orders even without a connection; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take card payment up front via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a final ordering time for dishes that must be ordered ahead.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: A private event is not shown on the map and has its own private ordering link and QR code — add as many such events as you need.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or a photo you already post on Facebook. You only need to review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically notify customers by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we will add your dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish as sold out with one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity — it goes down as orders come in, and when it runs out the dish automatically becomes sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone — no separate card terminal needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets in the kitchen on a Bluetooth or wired printer.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so orders are spread across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage walk-up orders at the truck, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Auto-replies to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the truck — and the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But every week you are somewhere different, at different times, where mobile signal is weak or missing. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering is paused automatically so customers cannot place orders you would not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times — you only need to share, every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.slotsTitle: Customers choose their own collection time
landing.does.title: Built for the food truck business, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where will you be tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” WhatsApp messages get answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill — from your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
